ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: As shown in the figure, this is a protein transport system in mitochondria. Similar to the situation in chloroplasts, proteins located in the mitochondrial matrix also require the assistance of specific molecular chaperones in order to be transported through the inner and outer membranes of the mitochondrion. During the transport process, they need to pass through the $\mathrm{TIM23}$ complex, and are then assisted by molecular chaperones in the matrix to fold into a functional conformation.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a mitochondrial protein transport system: the mitochondrion has an outer membrane, an intermembrane space, an inner membrane, and a mitochondrial matrix; the outer membrane is labeled with a TOM complex, and the inner membrane is labeled with a TIM complex; outside the mitochondrion there are cytosolic molecular chaperones, and in the mitochondrial matrix there are matrix molecular chaperones. The question stem states that proteins located in the mitochondrial matrix need to be transported through the inner and outer membranes, and that during the transport process they need to pass through the TIM23 complex. TOM and TIM/TIM23 are located on the mitochondrial membranes and perform the function of transmembrane transport channels, so this type of transport structure should be classified as a transmembrane protein complex.

method.method_draft: 先从图中读出被问到的转运结构位于线粒体膜系统上：TOM复合体在外膜处，TIM/TIM23复合体在内膜处，蛋白要经外膜和内膜进入基质。再从题干读出“转运过程中需要通过TIM23复合物”，说明所求对象是执行跨膜转运的膜上复合物。结合知识判断，TOM/TIM23这类嵌膜转运通道是跨膜蛋白复合体，因此答案写为“Transmembrane protein complexes”。
method.CoT_raw: 图像显示线粒体蛋白质转运系统：线粒体有外膜、膜间隙、内膜和线粒体基质；外膜处标有TOM复合体，内膜处标有TIM复合体；线粒体外侧有胞质分子伴侣，线粒体基质中有基质分子伴侣。题干说明定位在线粒体基质中的蛋白质需要通过内膜和外膜转运，且转运过程中需要通过TIM23复合物。TOM和TIM/TIM23位于线粒体膜上，承担跨膜转运通道功能，因此这类转运结构应归为跨膜蛋白复合体。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct structure-identification route: it uses the labels and positions in the diagram to classify TOM/TIM/TIM23 by where they sit, rather than relying on pathway chronology alone.
planner_metadata.image_role: 先观察图像：线粒体示意图标出外膜、膜间隙、内膜、线粒体基质；左侧膜上有标注为“TOM复合体”和“TIM复合体”的方块结构，跨在外膜/内膜相关位置，基质内还有“基质分子伴侣”，外侧有“胞质分子伴侣”。
planner_metadata.text_role: 题干提供线索：定位在线粒体基质的蛋白质需要通过内膜和外膜转运，且过程中需要通过TIM23复合物，之后才由基质分子伴侣折叠成有功能构型。
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 生物学桥接规则：名称中带有复合体且嵌在线粒体膜上的TOM/TIM/TIM23属于蛋白转运通道/转位酶，是由多个蛋白组成并跨膜分布的蛋白质复合体，即transmembrane protein complexes；分子伴侣负责维持或帮助折叠，不是膜通道本体。

TOM and TIM/TIM23 are located on the mitochondrial membranes and perform the function of transmembrane transport channels, so this type of transport structure should be classified as a transmembrane protein complex.
